messages:
Riya (security): Heads-up — FinCorp security review call tomorrow 9am PT. They want pre-call artifacts: RBAC revocation flow, audit log retention proof for tenant data, KMS rotation/export proof, and a short vuln-triage summary. Need everything in the ticket by EOD today. cc @Devon (product) @Alex (sre) :warning:

Alex (sre): I can grab audit log snippets + SIEM query. Will confirm retention policy (I think we keep tenant-level audit logs 90 days, aggregated events longer).

Jamie (infra): For RBAC changes I have the role-map CSV and the PR that removed the legacy service-role. Also we added an immediate token revoke endpoint in the session service last quarter — can share sequence diagram.

Devon (product): For KMS they specifically asked for proof-of-rotation metadata and which service accounts can perform import/rotate. Do we have an export script?

Riya (security): Yes — key-manager exposes rotation audit events. For hosted tenants we can export envelope metadata; for BYO-HSM customers we need the HSM audit extract (I can reach out to ops for that).

Alex (sre): Draft SIEM query I'll attach to the ticket:```
# SIEM query to pull tenant audit history
index=redwood-audit earliest=-90d | search tenant_id=fin-corp | stats count by actor, action, outcome | sort -count
```

Alex (sre): And command we use for rotation exports:```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $API" "https://keymgr.internal/api/v1/keys/rotation?tenant=fin-corp" > fincorp-key-rotation.json
```

Jamie (infra): RBAC artifacts: role-map CSV at https://git.internal/redwood/infra/role-maps/fin-corp.csv, PR #4821 changed service-role mappings (link attached in ticket). For revocation flow: sequence is 1) Admin disables account, 2) session-service issues revoke to session-cache, 3) prefix KV invalidation + audit event.

Devon (product): On vuln triage — we had one medium container CVE (CVE-2025-12345) patched in runtime v2.12.1. Patch PR + release notes: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/3345. Deployment started to Dedicated pools last week, can show rollout dashboard screenshot.

Riya (security): Good. We need small one-paragraph explanations for each artifact for the questionnaire. Alex/Jamie can you each drop a 2-3 line blurb explaining what the artifact proves?

Alex (sre): Will do. My blurb: "Audit export shows tenant-scoped events for principal activity and admin actions over the requested 90-day window, with immutable event IDs and signatures. SIEM query and raw JSON included."

Jamie (infra): My blurb: "RBAC role-map + PR demonstrate least-privilege mapping and the change record. Session revoke flow doc shows immediate revocation and session invalidation steps for revoked users/service accounts."

ticket-bot: Reminder — attach all artifacts to ticket FIN-1234 before 18:00 PT. :calendar:

Devon (product): I'll consolidate into the questionnaire template and ping legal for the HSM export wrap. Can someone paste the exact retention policy text we state to customers?

Riya (security): Policy text: "Tenant audit logs retained 90 days in raw form; 1-year aggregated telemetry retained for analytics. Customer-requested exports for compliance are provided via secure S3 export within 48 hours." Use that verbatim.

Alex (sre): Adding note: we also include KMS key rotation schedule in rotation manifest (fields: key_id, rotated_at, rotated_by, rotation_proof_sig). Will attach sample manifest.

Devon (product): Perfect. Plan: Alex + Jamie upload artifacts, I compile questionnaire, Riya does final review, then we attach to FIN-1234. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
